articles.description:
Hello, old friend.
Level-5 is really bringing out the throwbacks these days, huh? After years of waiting, the studio today unveiled a first look at Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain, confirming that it'll be coming to Switch 2.
We still know very little about this one at the time of writing, but the brief teaser trailer showed us a brief look at protagonist Nate and a couple of his Yo-kai pals. It's a remake of Yo-kai Watch 2: Bony Spirits & Fleshy Souls, which launched in Japan in 2014 before coming West two years later.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: 'Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain' Is Real, And It's Coming To Switch 2

articles.description:
Return of the Matt.
We don't have all that long to wait before Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launches on Switch 2 on 22nd October, and today, Nintendo has shared a few more details of what we can expect.
Chief among the newly revealed features is free island exploration. As showcased in the new trailer, you'll be able to make your way around Wuhu Island by skateboard, jet ski, or plane, and there are even collectible hibiscus flowers and Spocco Photos to collect while you're at it.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: New Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Trailer Showcases Some Wuhu Island Exploration

articles.description:
It's been 84 years.
After years of waiting and a fair few delays, Professor Layton and The New World of Steam finally has a Switch 1 & 2 release date: 10th December 2026.
The first mainline game in over a decade, The New World of Steam sees Layton and Luke team up in the land of Steam Bison — a hop across the pond from the pair's previous escapades — to solve the mystery of a phantom gunslinger terrorising the town.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Professor Layton And The New World Of Steam Finally Has A Release Date

articles.description:
New modes, plus a discount for owners of the original.
Koei Tecmo's Zelda spin-off Hyrule Warriors Age of Calamity is coming to Switch 2 on 27th February 2027 in Definitive Edition form.
As revealed in today's Nintendo Direct, the Musou spin-off and prequel story to Zelda: Breath of the Wild will get performance boosts, more enemies on screen at once, and will come with all the Expansion Pass content for the original, plus a new Calamity Mode which ups the difficulty to calamitous levels.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Hyrule Warriors: Age Of Calamity Is Getting Definitive Edition On Switch 2 Next February

articles.description:
Another pleasant surprise.
Following the announcement of Metroid Ravenous during today's Direct showcase, Nintendo has now revealed the box art and price for the upcoming game.
Starting with the digital price, Ravenous will be £49.99 / $59.99 for the digital versions, putting this on par with Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Another pleasant surprise then!
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Metroid Ravenous Price And Box Art Revealed

articles.description:
How did this one fare?
That's all, folks! After yesterday's Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, Nintendo has now wrapped up its general Direct, making for quite the jam-packed week for fans.
Nintendo spent 45 minutes on new announcements, updates, and reveals for the Switch 2, so to help you digest everything, we've compiled all of it right here.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Guide: Nintendo Direct September 2026 - Every Game, Announcement And Trailer

articles.description:
The Adventure Continues.
Back-to-back Star Fox news? What are the odds?
Nintendo had a dynamic duo of Star Fox drops for us in today's Direct. It kicked things off with the reveal that the recent Switch 2 release will soon be getting a free update, adding new Battle Mode stages and split-screen options (only at 30fps, mind) for those after a bit more competition. What's more, you'll be able to play with up to four players on a single system. Nice.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Star Fox Fans Are Eating Good, With An NSO Drop And A Switch 2 Update Inbound

articles.description:
Capcom's plugging gaps.
As part of today's Nintendo Direct, Capcom announced that Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition, Resident Evil 3, and Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition on 16th October.
Cloud versions of both 2 and 3 were released on Switch 1, but these are native ports and this is the first time Nintendo gamers will be able to get their hands on 2024's RE4 remake.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: A Trio Of Resident Evil Remakes Hit Switch 2 In October

articles.description:
Bit Persona-l.
After being announced for just about every other system, we had our fingers crossed that Persona 4 Revival might be making its way to Switch 2 too, and what do you know, it is!
This one will come our way on 20th May 2027 — a few months later than the PS5 release, but what can you do?
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Persona 4 Revival Is Officially Heading To Switch 2, With Persona 6 Teased For The Future

articles.description:
Deep breath.
A new 3D Kirby is on the horizon! Nintendo closed out today's Direct with a first look at Kirby and the World Beyond, revealing that it'll launch on Switch 2 in Spring 2027.
This one looks to be pretty open world, giving you huge areas to freely explore with Kirby's copy abilities. There's something quite Truman Show about the whole thing, showcasing the world's broken outer wall, with Kirby venturing beyond it.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: 'Kirby And The World Beyond' Goes Big On Switch 2 Next Spring

articles.description:
Super!
Yes, you read that right, Mario Kart World is finally getting a free content update. What's more, it's arriving today!
This new update sees the return of 10 classic Super Mario Kart circuits on the overworld. These are complete with the flat ? blocks that you remember from the SNES. These circuits can all be played as standalone races in VS Race mode.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Mario Kart World Goes Retro In New Free Update, Launching Today

articles.description:
Metroid 6, baby!
Nintendo has announced Metroid Ravenous for the Switch 2, the latest mainline entry in the iconic sci-fi series.
It will launch on 28th January 2027. Amiibo and a special edition have also been confirmed!
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Metroid Ravenous Announced For Switch 2, Release Date Confirmed

articles.description:
DAMNdori.
It feels like Nintendo has been taking its sweet time with it, but it's finally happening: Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is real, and it launches on 12th November.
This new edition packs in a fresh 'Dandori Academy' game mode to test your item-collecting skills, with three different difficulty modes and a whopping 72 stages to tackle. You'll even be able to see other players' scores, for a neat bit of competition.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Pikmin 4 Finally Gets The 'Switch 2 Edition' It Deserves This November

articles.description:
Details of old.
Round one of Nintendo's one-two punch of Direct presentations this week is now done and dusted, providing Zelda fans with a proper look at Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 along with a handful of intriguing 40th Anniversary initiatives.
As a reminder, we have another Direct presentation later today, with Nintendo promising a look at games launching during the Winter – along with a few surprises for the more distant future, no doubt.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Reaction: The Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Packs Insane Levels Of Detail, And It's Growing On Us

articles.description:
Maybe don't watch it, though..?
Nintendo showcased a sizeable chunk of gameplay from Zelda: Ocarina of Time for its 40th Anniversary Direct, but there's actually quite a bit more that you might not have seen yet.
Nintendo's main site for Japan contains lots of extra bits and bobs, and we've only gone and compiled it into one handy video.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Video: Here's A Bunch More Gameplay From Zelda: Ocarina Of Time On Switch 2

articles.description:
Plus the new Pro Controller and amiibo.
Nintendo lifted the lid on its Ocarina of Time remake in its September 2026 Direct, revealing a stunningly detailed reimagining of the N64 classic. It's scheduled to launch on 5th November, with special Zelda-themed Switch 2 hardware and accessories arriving earlier, on 29th October.
In this guide, we've rounded up The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 pre-orders from retailers in the UK and US, including the new console, Zelda-themed Pro Controller, and amiibo.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Guide: Where To Pre-Order The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time & Zelda Nintendo Switch 2 Console

Look!
The digital listing for the Switch 2 version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is now live on the eShop and it includes the game's estimated file size.
According to Nintendo's official store, Link's classic Nintendo 64 quest "remade for a whole new era" is estimated to be 27GB.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Switch 2 Estimated File Size Revealed

articles.description:
Celebrating 40 years of Link.

Nintendo has announced all sorts of merch for The Legend of Zelda's 40th anniversary, but one item you might have missed is the new trading card series.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Zelda: Master Collection Trading Cards Are On The Way

articles.description:
A link between games.
Hopefully by now you've seen Zelda: Ocarina of Time in action on the Switch 2, and if you're anything like us, you were quite simply blown away by the sheer leap in visual quality when compared to the original.
To really demonstrate just how much the remake improves upon the N64 game, the lovely chaps over at GVG have provided a side-by-side comparison of the two games. Essentially, the same footage from Eiji Aonuma's gameplay demonstration is shown, but with similar footage from the N64 original playing next to it.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Video: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Side-By-Side Comparison, Switch 2 Vs. N64

articles.description:
Dates in Edinburgh, Glasgow, Stockholm, San Francisco and more already revealed.
The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Concert will tour the globe starting in January 2027.
It'll feature music from the entire series - from "nostalgic tunes to modern melodies", according to an official blurb - and tour across Japan, North America, Europe and Australia.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Guide: All Confirmed Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Concert Tour Dates In UK, Europe, North America, Japan & Australia

articles.description:
Open your eyes... and look at these screens!
Well, that sure was a lot! As a part of today's Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, we got our first extended look at The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2, and we mean an extended look.
Aonuma-san kicked things off with a full 15-minute gameplay session, followed by a new trailer that showcased... just about the whole game, it seems. A bunch of us here at Nintendo Life Towers were a little teary-eyed throughout the whole thing, truth be told, so we thought it was only right that we assemble the following gallery so we can all get a closer look at the damn thing.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Gallery: Here's A Closer Look At Zelda: Ocarina Of Time On Switch 2
